module.Title: Convert a Pressure Reading
module.Teaching: Values from input() are text. float() converts numeric text into a decimal number that can be calculated.
PredictionOptions: To convert text into a decimal number
module.PredictionExplanation: float() converts numeric text into a decimal value.
module.DebugPrompt: Call input() first, then pass its returned text into float().
module.RecallPrompt: Collect and convert a pressure reading using float(input(...)). Use the exact value "Enter pressure: ".
module.TransferPrompt: Collect and convert an integer cycle count. Use these exact identifiers: cycle_count, input, int. Use the exact value "Enter cycle count: ".
module.PreviewMessage: The terminal can now perform math with operator-entered readings.
